verses.sloka: सा वीरसमिती राज्ञा विरराज व्यवस्थिता ।शशिना शुभिनक्षत्रा पौर्णमासीव शारदी ॥६-२४-१॥।।
verses.transliteration: sā vīrasamitī rājñā virarāja vyavasthitā ।śaśinā śubhinakṣatrā paurṇamāsīva śāradī ॥6-24-1॥।।

translations.english: The army of Vanaras settled that way by Rama's command shone like the autumnal full moon with auspicious stars.
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्ड का तेईसवाँ सगं पूरा हुआ । धा गि i (७ सर ७३ चतुविशः सग; सा १वीरसमिती राज्ञा विरराज व्यवस्थिता शशिना शुभनचत्रा पौर्णमासीव शारदी

verses.sloka: प्रचचाल च वेगेन त्रस्ता चैव वसुन्धरा ।पीड्यमाना बलौ घेन तेन सागरवर्चसा ॥६-२४-२॥।।
verses.transliteration: pracacāla ca vegena trastā caiva vasundharā ।pīḍyamānā balau ghena tena sāgaravarcasā ॥6-24-2॥।।

translations.english: The frightened army (of Vanaras) that was like a tormented ocean started moving swiftly, shaking like the earth.
translations.hindi: समुद्र के समान विशाल वानर-वाहिनी के वेग से वहाँ की भूमि पीडति हुई रौर डर कर काँप उठी

verses.sloka: ततः शुश्रुपुराक्रुष्टम् लङ्कायाः काननौकसः ।भेरीमृदङ्गसम्घुष्टम् तुमुलम् रोमहर्षणम् ॥६-२४-३॥।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śuśrupurākruṣṭam laṅkāyāḥ kānanaukasaḥ ।bherīmṛdaṅgasamghuṣṭam tumulam romaharṣaṇam ॥6-24-3॥।।

translations.english: There upon having settled down, the army hordes heard from Lanka terrific and tumultuous noise of drums and percussion instruments that caused horripilation.

verses.sloka: बभूवुस्तेन घोषेण सम्हृष्टा हरियूथपाः ।अमृष्यमाणास्तम् घोषम् विनेदुर्घोषवत्तरम् ॥६-२४-४॥।।
verses.transliteration: babhūvustena ghoṣeṇa samhṛṣṭā hariyūthapāḥ ।amṛṣyamāṇāstam ghoṣam vinedurghoṣavattaram ॥6-24-4॥।।

translations.english: The leaders of Vanara troops felt very happy at the noise from (Lanka) which they were unable to tolerate and roared louder (than that in joy).
translations.hindi: उस घोष को सुनने से कपियूथपति बहुत प्रसन्न हुए और इस शब्द को सहन न कर, ये वानर भी बड़े जोर से चिल्लाने लगे

verses.sloka: राक्षसास्तम् प्लवङ्गानाम् शुश्रुवुस्तेऽपि गर्जितम् ।वर्दतामिव दृप्तानाम् मेघानामम्बरे स्वनम् ॥६-२४-५॥।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasāstam plavaṅgānām śuśruvuste'pi garjitam ।vardatāmiva dṛptānām meghānāmambare svanam ॥6-24-5॥।।

translations.english: Even the Rakshasas heard the roaring of Vanaras in their pride that was bellowing like that of clouds in the sky.
translations.hindi: लङ्कावासी रात्तसों ने उन गर्वीले और सिंहनाद करते हुए बानरों का ऐसा शब्द सुना जेसा कि) आकाश मे मेथो के गरजने से हुआ करता है

verses.sloka: दृष्ट्वा दाशरथिर्लङ्काम् चित्रध्वजपताकिनिम्म् ।जगाम मनसा सीताम् दूयमानेन चेतसा ॥६-२४-६॥।।
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā dāśarathirlaṅkām citradhvajapatākinimm ।jagāma manasā sītām dūyamānena cetasā ॥6-24-6॥।।

translations.english: Afflicted by sorrow upon seeing the colourful flags and posts of Lanka even Rama's thoughts went about thinking of Sita.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी रंगबिरंगी ध्त्रजा पताकां से शोभित लङ्का को देख, सीता का स्मरण कर, अत्यन्त दुःखित हुए

verses.sloka: अत्र सा मृगशाबाक्षी रावणेनोपरुध्यते ।अभिभूता ग्रहेणेव लोहिताङ्गेन रोहिणी ॥६-२४-७॥।।
verses.transliteration: atra sā mṛgaśābākṣī rāvaṇenoparudhyate ।abhibhūtā graheṇeva lohitāṅgena rohiṇī ॥6-24-7॥।।

translations.english: The doveeyed Sita is obstructed by Ravana there (at Lanka) like the planet Rohini is caught by the red coloured planet (Mars).
translations.hindi: ओर सोचने लगे कि, इस समय वह मृगलोचनी जानकी रावण के घर में कैद है । सो इस समय उसकी वही शोच्य दशा होगी, जो मङ्गलग्रह से ग्रसी हुई रोहिणी की होती है

verses.sloka: दीर्घमुष्णम् च निःश्वस्य समुद्वीक्ष्य च लक्ष्मणम् ।उवाच वचनम् वीरस्तत्कालहितमात्मनः ॥६-२४-८॥।।
verses.transliteration: dīrghamuṣṇam ca niḥśvasya samudvīkṣya ca lakṣmaṇam ।uvāca vacanam vīrastatkālahitamātmanaḥ ॥6-24-8॥।।

translations.english: Heroic Rama heaving hot and long breath looking at Lakshmana spoke these words that were good for him at that time.
translations.hindi: लेत्री और गर्म साँस ले तथा लक्ष्मण जी की ओर भली भाँति निहार, महात्रीर श्रीरामचन्द्र युद्धयात्रा के समयानुरूप हितप्रद एवं शोक भुलाने वाले (तथा नगर का शोभावणनरूपी ) वचन बोले

verses.sloka: आलिखन्तीमिवाकाशमुत्थिताम् पश्य लक्ष्मण ।मन्सेव कृताम् लङ्काम् नगाग्रे विश्वकर्मणा ॥६-२४-९॥।।
verses.transliteration: ālikhantīmivākāśamutthitām paśya lakṣmaṇa ।manseva kṛtām laṅkām nagāgre viśvakarmaṇā ॥6-24-9॥।।

translations.english: "Lakshmana, you may see the city of Lanka elevated on top of the mountain as though clasping the sky, like the one created in the mind of Vishwakarma."

verses.sloka: विमानैर्बहुभिर्लङ्क सम्कीर्णा रचिता पुरा ।विष्णोः पदमिवाकाशम् चादितम् पाण्डुभिर्घनैः ॥६-२४-१०॥।।
verses.transliteration: vimānairbahubhirlaṅka samkīrṇā racitā purā ।viṣṇoḥ padamivākāśam cāditam pāṇḍubhirghanaiḥ ॥6-24-10॥।।

translations.english: "This Lanka appears splendid with a mass of skyscrapers like white clouds covering the path of Vishnu in the sky."

verses.sloka: पुष्पितैः शोभिता लङ्का वनैश्चत्ररथोपमैः ।नानापतगसम्घुष्टफलपुष्पोपगैः शुभैः ॥६-२४-११॥।।
verses.transliteration: puṣpitaiḥ śobhitā laṅkā vanaiścatrarathopamaiḥ ।nānāpatagasamghuṣṭaphalapuṣpopagaiḥ śubhaiḥ ॥6-24-11॥।।

translations.english: "Lanka is filled with flocks of birds of several kinds singing sweetly, the gardens with charming flowers and fruits are delighting like auspicious gardens of Chaitrara, the garden of Kubera, the god of wealth."
translations.hindi: प्रथिवी के ऊपर अनेक तलों के घरों से युक्त जङ्का सी शोभायमान हो रही हे; जैसे सफेद बादलों से ढका हुआ आकाश ॥ १०) पुष्पितेः शोमिता लङ्का बनैश्वैत्रसथोपमः । नानापतङ्गसंघष्ट; पसएुन पप शुभ

verses.sloka: पश्य मत्तविहङ्गनि प्रलीनभ्रमराणि च ।कोकिलाकुलखण्डानि दोधवीति शिवोऽविलः ॥६-२४-१२॥।।
verses.transliteration: paśya mattavihaṅgani pralīnabhramarāṇi ca ।kokilākulakhaṇḍāni dodhavīti śivo'vilaḥ ॥6-24-12॥।।

translations.english: "You may see the trees shaking violently by the pleasant breeze, inhabited by proud birds, drunken honeybees and crowded with cuckoos and other birds (Rama said to Lakshmana)."
translations.hindi: ध्य देखो, मतवाले पदी बच्चों पर बैठे हैं, मधुपान के भूखे भोरे गँजते हुए फूलों में घुसे बैठे हैं। कोकिलाओं के कुंड के शुड बैठे हैं । देखो, केली सुखावह हवा वह रही है, जो बार बार बक्षों को हिला रही है

verses.sloka: इति दाशरथीरमो लक्ष्मणम् समभाषत ।बलम् च तत्र विभजच्चास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा ॥६-२४-१३॥।।
verses.transliteration: iti dāśarathīramo lakṣmaṇam samabhāṣata ।balam ca tatra vibhajaccāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā ॥6-24-13॥।।

translations.english: Dasaratha's son Rama thus talked to Lakshmana in that manner and asked to divide the task of the army in accordance with what is said in sastras.

verses.sloka: शशास कपिसेमाम् ताम् बलादादाय वीर्यवान् ।अङ्गदः सह नीलेन तिष्ठे दुरपि दुर्जयः ॥६-२४-१४॥।।
verses.transliteration: śaśāsa kapisemām tām balādādāya vīryavān ।aṅgadaḥ saha nīlena tiṣṭhe durapi durjayaḥ ॥6-24-14॥।।

translations.english: Let the valiant Angada who is difficult to win over, who is a terror to the enemies, take the army along with Nila and remain at the centre (of the army structure).
translations.hindi: हो 6 शशास कपिसेनाया बलभादाय वीयवान्‌ । n 258 2 0 आङ्गद्‌ः सह नीलेन तिष्डेदुरसि दुजंयः

verses.sloka: तिष्ठेद्वानरवाहिन्या वानरौघसमावृतः ।आशिर्तो दक्षिणम् पार्श्वमृषभो नाम वानरः ॥६-२४-१५॥।।
verses.transliteration: tiṣṭhedvānaravāhinyā vānaraughasamāvṛtaḥ ।āśirto dakṣiṇam pārśvamṛṣabho nāma vānaraḥ ॥6-24-15॥।।

translations.english: Let Rshaba the bull among Vanaras approach the south side of the army accompanied by his troop of Vanara contingent and remain there.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने कहा ) इस वानरसेना की दाहिनी ओर कपिश्रेष्ठ छपभ अपनी अधीनस्थ सेना के साथ रहें

verses.sloka: गन्धहस्तीव दुर्धर्षस्तरस्वी गन्धमादनः ।तिष्ठेद्वानरवाहिन्याः सव्यम् पक्षमधिष्ठतः ॥६-२४-१६॥।।
verses.transliteration: gandhahastīva durdharṣastarasvī gandhamādanaḥ ।tiṣṭhedvānaravāhinyāḥ savyam pakṣamadhiṣṭhataḥ ॥6-24-16॥।।

translations.english: "Let the mighty Gandhamadana, a difficult one to conquer like a proud elephant, take the battalion of army and stay on the right side"

verses.sloka: मूर्ध्नि स्थास्याम्यहम् यत्तो लक्ष्मणेन समन्वितः ।जाम्बवाम्श्च सुषेणश्च वेगदर्शी च वानरः ॥६-२४-१७॥।।
verses.transliteration: mūrdhni sthāsyāmyaham yatto lakṣmaṇena samanvitaḥ ।jāmbavāmśca suṣeṇaśca vegadarśī ca vānaraḥ ॥6-24-17॥।।

translations.english: "I and Lakshmana will be alert at the head side. Let Jambavan Sushena and the three chiefs of Bears who are strong and quick at sighting remain protecting the belly of the army."

verses.sloka: ऋक्षमुख्या महात्मानः कुक्षिम् रक्षन्तु ते त्रयः ।जघनम् कपिसेनायाः कपिराजोऽभिरक्षतु ॥६-२४-१८॥।।
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣamukhyā mahātmānaḥ kukṣim rakṣantu te trayaḥ ।jaghanam kapisenāyāḥ kapirājo'bhirakṣatu ॥6-24-18॥।।

translations.english: "Just as Pracheta who is covered by brilliance, rules the western side of the world, let the king of Vanaras protect the hips and loin portion of the Vanara army."

verses.sloka: पश्चार्धमिव लोकस्य प्रचेतास्तेजपा वृतः ।सुविभक्तमहाव्यूहा महावानररक्षिता ॥६-२४-१९॥।।
verses.transliteration: paścārdhamiva lokasya pracetāstejapā vṛtaḥ ।suvibhaktamahāvyūhā mahāvānararakṣitā ॥6-24-19॥।।

translations.english: The Vanara army force organized that way to protect the Vanaras, shone like the mass of clouds in heaven.

verses.sloka: अनीकिनी सा विबभौ यथाद्यौः साभ्रसम्प्लवा ।प्रऋह्य गिरिशृङ्गाणि महतश्च महीरुहान् ॥६-२४-२०॥।।
verses.transliteration: anīkinī sā vibabhau yathādyauḥ sābhrasamplavā ।praṛhya giriśṛṅgāṇi mahataśca mahīruhān ॥6-24-20॥।।

translations.english: Vanaras resolved to go taking peaks of mountains and huge trees to smash Lanka in war.
translations.hindi: उस समय वह वानरी सेना ऐसी शोभित हुई, जैसे आकाश भेघों से शोभित होता है । वानरगण गिरिश्वङ्गों और बड़े बडे वर्षां को ले

verses.sloka: आसेदुर्वानरा लङ्काम् मिमर्दयुषवो रणे ।शिखरैर्विकिरामैनाम् लङ्काम् मुष्टिभिरेव वा ॥६-२४-२१॥।।
verses.transliteration: āsedurvānarā laṅkām mimardayuṣavo raṇe ।śikharairvikirāmainām laṅkām muṣṭibhireva vā ॥6-24-21॥।।

translations.english: Thus resolved the Vanara leaders in their mind to crush Lanka with its mountain peaks into powder with their bare fists, indeed.
translations.hindi: लङ्का को ध्वस्त करने के लिए चढ़ाई करने की आज्ञा की प्रतीक्षा करने लगे वे सब श्रपने अपने मनों में सोचने लग कि, पर्वेतशिखरों अथवा घंसों से हम लङ्का को पीस डालेंगे । तब श्रीरामचन्द्र ने सुग्रीव से कहा

verses.sloka: इति स्म दधिरे सर्वे मानाम्सि हरिपुङ्गवाः ।ततो रामो महातेजाः सुग्रीव मिदमब्रवीत् ॥६-२४-२२॥।।
verses.transliteration: iti sma dadhire sarve mānāmsi haripuṅgavāḥ ।tato rāmo mahātejāḥ sugrīva midamabravīt ॥6-24-22॥।।

translations.english: Having heard Sugriva, there after splendid Rama spoke thus. "The army is divided (placed in position). Suka may be relieved."

verses.sloka: सुविभक्तानि सैन्यानि शुक एष विमुच्यताम् ।रामस्य तु वचः श्रुत्वा वानरेन्द्रो महाबलः ॥६-२४-२३॥।।
verses.transliteration: suvibhaktāni sainyāni śuka eṣa vimucyatām ।rāmasya tu vacaḥ śrutvā vānarendro mahābalaḥ ॥6-24-23॥।।

translations.english: Having heard Rama's words Sugriva, the mighty king of Vanaras was happy and relieved the envoy on the instruction of Rama.
translations.hindi: मित्र ! सेना तो यथास्थान टिक गई । अब शुक को छोड़ देना चाहिये । श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का यह वचन सुन, महाबली कपिराज सुग्रीव ने

verses.sloka: मोचयामास तम् दूतम् शुकम् रामस्य शासनात् ।मोचितो रामवाक्येन वानरैश्च निपीडितः ॥६-२४-२४॥।।
verses.transliteration: mocayāmāsa tam dūtam śukam rāmasya śāsanāt ।mocito rāmavākyena vānaraiśca nipīḍitaḥ ॥6-24-24॥।।

translations.english: Relieved by the word of Rama, tormented Suka who was highly terrified returned to the king of Rakshasas.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की आज्ञा से रावण के उस दूत शुक को छोड़ दिया । श्रीराम की आज्ञा से दटा हुआ ओर वानरों द्वारा सताया हुआ

verses.sloka: शुकः परमसम्त्रस्तो रक्षोधिपमुपागमत् ।रावणः प्रहसन्नेव शुकम् वाक्यमुवाच ह ॥६-२४-२५॥।।
verses.transliteration: śukaḥ paramasamtrasto rakṣodhipamupāgamat ।rāvaṇaḥ prahasanneva śukam vākyamuvāca ha ॥6-24-25॥।।

translations.english: Laughing at Suka, Ravana spoke these words. "Why are your wings fastened? Your wings have been clipped, it appears!. I suppose you have not fallen under the clutches of the fickle minded Vanaras!"
translations.hindi: शुक अत्यन्त डरा हुआ रावण के पास पहुंचा । रावण ने शुक को देख, मुसकुराते हुए पूछा

verses.sloka: किमिमौ ते सितौ पक्षौ लूनपक्ष्श्च दृश्यसे ।कच्चिन्नानेकचित्तानाम् तेषाम् त्वम् वशमागतः ॥६-२४-२६॥।।
verses.transliteration: kimimau te sitau pakṣau lūnapakṣśca dṛśyase ।kaccinnānekacittānām teṣām tvam vaśamāgataḥ ॥6-24-26॥।।

translations.english: Laughing at Suka, Ravana spoke these words. "Why are your wings fastened? Your wings have been clipped, it appears!. I suppose you have not fallen under the clutches of the fickle minded Vanaras!"
translations.hindi: हे शुक ! तुम्हारे ये सफेद पंख नांचे खसोटे क्यों देख पड़ते हैं। तुम कहीं उन चञ्चलमना बानरों के फदे भें तो नहीं फंस गये

verses.sloka: ततस्प भयसम्विग्न स्तदा राज्ञाभिचोदितः ।वचनम् प्रत्युवाचेदम् राक्षसाधिपमुत्तमम् ॥६-२४-२७॥।।
verses.transliteration: tataspa bhayasamvigna stadā rājñābhicoditaḥ ।vacanam pratyuvācedam rākṣasādhipamuttamam ॥6-24-27॥।।

translations.english: Then Suka who was caught by fear, having been asked by the king, trembling away thus replied to the Rakshasa king. "I went to the northern shore of the ocean and delivered gently the speech just as it was conveyed by you."
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्डे वह भयभीत झु, राक्षतराज छार पूछा जाकर, रावण को इस प्रकार उत्तर देता हुआ

verses.sloka: सागरस्योत्तरे तीरेऽब्रवम् ते वचनम् तथा ।यथासम्देशमक्लिष्टम् सान्त्वयन् श्लक्ष्णया गिरा ॥६-२४-२८॥।।
verses.transliteration: sāgarasyottare tīre'bravam te vacanam tathā ।yathāsamdeśamakliṣṭam sāntvayan ślakṣṇayā girā ॥6-24-28॥।।

translations.english: Then Suka who was caught by fear, having been asked by the king, trembling away thus replied to the Rakshasa king. "I went to the northern shore of the ocean and delivered gently the speech just as it was conveyed by you."

verses.sloka: क्रुद्धैस्तेरहमुत्प्लुत्य दृष्टमात्रः प्लवङ्गमैः ।गृहितोऽस्म्यपि चारब्धो हन्तुम् लोप्तुम् च मुष्टिभिः ॥६-२४-२९॥।।
verses.transliteration: kruddhaisterahamutplutya dṛṣṭamātraḥ plavaṅgamaiḥ ।gṛhito'smyapi cārabdho hantum loptum ca muṣṭibhiḥ ॥6-24-29॥।।

translations.english: As soon as they saw me, the enraged Vanaras rising up (into the sky) took hold of me and started injuring me and slaying me.

verses.sloka: न ते सम्भाषितुम् शक्याः सम्प्रश्नोऽत्र न विद्यते ।प्रकृत्या कोपनास्तीक्षिणा वानरा राक्षसाधिप ॥६-२४-३०॥।।
verses.transliteration: na te sambhāṣitum śakyāḥ sampraśno'tra na vidyate ।prakṛtyā kopanāstīkṣiṇā vānarā rākṣasādhipa ॥6-24-30॥।।

translations.english: "O king of Rakshasas! It was not possible to negotiate there with the Vanaras). I had no opportunity to interrogate with them. By nature, Vanaras are violent and are highly furious."

verses.sloka: स च हन्ता विराधस्य कबन्धस्य खरस्य च ।सुग्रीवसहितो रामः सीतायाः पदमागतः ॥६-२४-३१॥।।
verses.transliteration: sa ca hantā virādhasya kabandhasya kharasya ca ।sugrīvasahito rāmaḥ sītāyāḥ padamāgataḥ ॥6-24-31॥।।

translations.english: "The life of Viradha, Kabhanda and Khara has been taken away by Rama. Accompanied by Sugriva they have set their foot into Lanka for Sita's sake."
translations.hindi: तत्पश्चान्‌ मैंने विराध, कबन्ध और खर को मारने वाले श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को देखा, जो सुश्री व के साथ सीता के रने के स्थान का पता पा कर, यहाँ आये हैं

verses.sloka: स कृत्वा सागरे सेतुम् तीर्त्वा च लवणोदधिम् ।एष रक्षासि निर्धूय धन्वी तिष्ठति राघवः ॥६-२४-३२॥।।
verses.transliteration: sa kṛtvā sāgare setum tīrtvā ca lavaṇodadhim ।eṣa rakṣāsi nirdhūya dhanvī tiṣṭhati rāghavaḥ ॥6-24-32॥।।

translations.english: "Mighty Raghava having crossed the salt sea and reached the shore of Rakshasas, organized them (Vanaras) and stood wielding a bow."
translations.hindi: समुद्र का पुल बाँच, लवशसागर को पार कर और राक्षसा को तिन के के समान जान; हाथ में धनुष लिये हुए श्रीरामचन्द्र ज्ञी आ पहुँचे हैं

verses.sloka: ऋक्षवानरसम्घानामनीकानि सहस्रशः ।गिरिमेघनिकाशानाम् चादयन्ति वसुन्धराम् ॥६-२४-३३॥।।
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣavānarasamghānāmanīkāni sahasraśaḥ ।girimeghanikāśānām cādayanti vasundharām ॥6-24-33॥।।

translations.english: "Thousands of army forces of monkeys and Bears resembling mountains and clouds have settled on the ground."
translations.hindi: उनके साथ में बड़े बड़े रीछों और बानरों की हजारों सेनाएँ हैं । वे रीछ और वानर पर्वत अथवा मेघ की तरह विशालकाय हैं और उनकी संख्या इतनी अधिक है कि, वे पुथिवी को ढाँपे हुए हैं

verses.sloka: राक्षसानाम् बलौघस्य वानरेन्द्रबलस्य च ।नैतयोर्विद्यते सम्धिर्देवदानवयोरिव ॥६-२४-३४॥।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasānām balaughasya vānarendrabalasya ca ।naitayorvidyate samdhirdevadānavayoriva ॥6-24-34॥।।

translations.english: Alliance is not possible between Rakshasas and army of Bears and Vanaras, just as alliance is not possible between gods and demons.

verses.sloka: पुरा प्राकारमायान्ति क्षिप्रमेकतरम् कुरु ।सीताम् वास्मै प्रयच्चाशु युद्धम् वापि प्रदीयताम् ॥६-२४-३५॥।।
verses.transliteration: purā prākāramāyānti kṣipramekataram kuru ।sītām vāsmai prayaccāśu yuddham vāpi pradīyatām ॥6-24-35॥।।

translations.english: "They will reach the boundary wall. At once you may do one of the two that I suggest you do. I implore you either to give away Sita or give good battle."
translations.hindi: वे लङ्का पर चढ़ाई करना ही चाहते हैं, अतएव आप अति शीघ्र इन दो में से एक कास कीजिए तो आप तुरन्त सीता को दे दें या सलीभाँति कमर कस व उनसे लड

verses.sloka: शुकस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा रावणो वाक्य मब्रवीत् ।रोषसम्रक्तनयनो निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा ॥६-२४-३६॥।।
verses.transliteration: śukasya vacanam śrutvā rāvaṇo vākya mabravīt ।roṣasamraktanayano nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā ॥6-24-36॥।।

translations.english: Angry, redeyed Ravana, having heard Suka's words spoke as though he would burn him with his glance.
translations.hindi: शुक की इन बातों को सुन, रावण कहने लगा । उस समय मारेक्रोध के उसकी आँखें लाल हो रही थींओर ऐसा जान पड़ता था कि मानों वह नेत्राग्नि से शुक को भरम कर डालेगा

verses.sloka: यदि माम् प्रतियुध्येरन् देवगन्धर्वदानवाः ।नैव सीताम् प्रदास्यामि सर्वलोकभयादपि ॥६-२४-३७॥।।
verses.transliteration: yadi mām pratiyudhyeran devagandharvadānavāḥ ।naiva sītām pradāsyāmi sarvalokabhayādapi ॥6-24-37॥।।

translations.english: "Even if gods, Gandharvas and demons come to wage war with me, even if all the worlds threaten me, I shall not give away Sita."

verses.sloka: कदा समभिधानन्ति मामका राघवम् शराः ।वसन्ते पुष्पितम् मत्ता भ्रमरा इव पादपम् ॥६-२४-३८॥।।
verses.transliteration: kadā samabhidhānanti māmakā rāghavam śarāḥ ।vasante puṣpitam mattā bhramarā iva pādapam ॥6-24-38॥।।

translations.english: "Just as drunken bees reach the trees with blossoms in spring when will my arrows attack Rama?"

verses.sloka: कदा शोणितदिग्धाङ्गम् दीपैः कार्मुकविच्युतैः ।शरैरादीपयिष्यामि उल्काभिरिव कुञ्जरम् ॥६-२४-३९॥।।
verses.transliteration: kadā śoṇitadigdhāṅgam dīpaiḥ kārmukavicyutaiḥ ।śarairādīpayiṣyāmi ulkābhiriva kuñjaram ॥6-24-39॥।।

translations.english: "When will the glowing arrows from my quiver, that are fit to pierce in thousands, be able to goad Rama like the burning fire sticks goad the elephants?"

verses.sloka: तच्चास्य बलमादास्ये बलेन महता वृतः ।ज्योतिषामिव सर्वेषाम् प्रभामुद्यन्दिवाकरः ॥६-२४-४०॥।।
verses.transliteration: taccāsya balamādāsye balena mahatā vṛtaḥ ।jyotiṣāmiva sarveṣām prabhāmudyandivākaraḥ ॥6-24-40॥।।

translations.english: "Just as the rising Sun light obscures the radiance of all (other stars) when will I obscure him surrounded by his army?"

verses.sloka: सागरस्येव मे वेगो मारुतस्येव मे बलम् ।न च दाशरथिर्वेद तेन माम् योद्धुमिच्चति ॥६-२४-४१॥।।
verses.transliteration: sāgarasyeva me vego mārutasyeva me balam ।na ca dāśarathirveda tena mām yoddhumiccati ॥6-24-41॥।।

translations.english: "I have the speed of the ocean and swiftness like the WindGod. Rama does not know this and desires to wage war with me."
translations.hindi: सागर की तरह मेरा वेग छै और पत्रन की तरह सेरी गति है. । यह बात श्रीराम नहीं जानता, इसीसे तो बह मुझसे लड़ना चाहता है

verses.sloka: न मे तूणीशयान् बाणान् सनिषानिव पन्नगान् ।रामः पश्यति सम्ग्रामे तेन माम् योद्धुमिच्चति ॥६-२४-४२॥।।
verses.transliteration: na me tūṇīśayān bāṇān saniṣāniva pannagān ।rāmaḥ paśyati samgrāme tena mām yoddhumiccati ॥6-24-42॥।।

translations.english: "Rama has not seen the poisonous arrows in my quiver in battle. Therefore, he is desiring comb at with me."
translations.hindi: तरकस में, विषधर सांपों की तरह पड़े हुए मेरे विषेले बाण, श्रीराम को नहीं देख पडते, इसीसे वह मेरे साथ लड़ना चाहता है

verses.sloka: न जानाति पुरा वीर्यम् मम युद्धे स राघवः ।मम चापमयीम् वीणाम् शरकोणैः प्रवादिताम् ॥६-२४-४३॥।।
verses.transliteration: na jānāti purā vīryam mama yuddhe sa rāghavaḥ ।mama cāpamayīm vīṇām śarakoṇaiḥ pravāditām ॥6-24-43॥।।

translations.english: "He has not known my valour in war. Entering the enemy's army holding my formidable Veena, making challenging sounds with the sharp heads of arrows, causing tumultuous noise like the sound of cry of destitute and frightened ones with iron arrows, I will play the Veena of my bow in hand."
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र ने मेरे साथ पहिले कभी युद्ध नहीं गे । इसीसे वह मेरा बल पराक्रम नहीं जानता । जिस समय शत्रु की सेनारूपी नदी में डुबकी लगा, पनी चॉपसयी बीणा, MR कल १ कोणैः--वीणाबादनदणडैः ( गो० ) २१० युद्धकारडे तीररूप गज से वजञाऊँगा और जब रोदे की टङ्कार . होगी तथा a घायलों और भयभीत हुए सैनिकों का हाहाकार सुन पड़ेगा और तीरों की सनसनाहट सुन पड़ेगी

verses.sloka: ज्याशबदतुमुलाम् घोरामार्तगीतमहास्वनाम् ।नाराचतलसम्नादाम् ताम् ममाहितवाहिनीम् ॥६-२४-४४॥।।
verses.transliteration: jyāśabadatumulām ghorāmārtagītamahāsvanām ।nārācatalasamnādām tām mamāhitavāhinīm ॥6-24-44॥।।

translations.english: "He has not known my valour in war. Entering the enemy's army holding my formidable Veena, making challenging sounds with the sharp heads of arrows, causing tumultuous noise like the sound of cry of destitute and frightened ones with iron arrows, I will play the Veena of my bow in hand."
translations.hindi: इति चतुर्वि शः सगः उस समय न तो सहदस्नाच इन्द्र की अथवा स्मयं वरुण की अथवा यम की अथवा कुबेर की यह मजाल है कि, इनमें से भो कोई मेरे साथ महायुद्ध में मेरे.बाणाशि का सामना कर सके

verses.sloka: अवगाह्य महरङ्गम् वादयिष्यान्तगन् रणे ।न वासवेनापि स हस्रचक्षुषा ।युद्धेऽस्मि शक्यो वरुणेन वास्वयम् ।यमेव वा धर्षयितुम् शराग्निना ।महाहवे वैश्रवणेन वा स्वयम् ॥६-२४-४५॥
verses.transliteration: avagāhya maharaṅgam vādayiṣyāntagan raṇe ।na vāsavenāpi sa hasracakṣuṣā ।yuddhe'smi śakyo varuṇena vāsvayam ।yameva vā dharṣayitum śarāgninā ।mahāhave vaiśravaṇena vā svayam ॥6-24-45॥

translations.english: "It is not possible (to win over) for the thousand eyed Indra, or even Varuna, the god presiding over water, or even for Yama, the god of death and again even for Kubera the god of wealth to face the fire of my arrows (said Ravana to Suka)." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकावेयुध्दकाण्डेचतुर्विंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the twenty fourth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic, the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
